newsitem.title: USA: National Computer to buy software company.
newsitem.headline: National Computer to buy software company.

text.p: National Computer Systems Inc said on Monday it signed a letter of intent to acquire Macro Educational Systems Inc and will take an unspecified one-time charge at closing.

National Computer said it will pay $7.0 million in cash at closing and $7 million of convertible debentures for Macro Educations, which develops administrative software systems for the kindergarten to grade 12 education market.
The company said the charge at closing will be for acquisition of in-process research and development and other acquisition-related costs to be incurred.

National Computer said the debentures will be convertible into its stock over a five-year term with the conversion price fixed at closing. Additional payments may be earned contingent on financial performance.
It is anticipated the transaction will be completed before January 31, which is the end of NCS' current fiscal year.
Completion of the transaction is subject to the negotiation and execution of a definitive acquisition agreement, and receiving regulatory approvals.
